name: dsh-web-fetch-local
description: `web_fetch` tool backed by local Python urllib + SSRF blocklist (any public host is allowed).

scripts.test: python src/fetch.py --url https://github.com 2>&1 | python -c "import sys,json; r=json.loads(sys.stdin.read().splitlines()[0]); assert r['ok']==True, r; print('SSRF-blocked test OK')"
